name: 18 Colors Nude Eyeshadow Palette | Matte & Shimmer Pigmented Shades, Long-Lasting
description:
The 18 Colors Nude Eyeshadow Palette features a mix of highly pigmented matte, shimmer, and metallic shades to create endless looks for day and night. Smooth and easy to blend, the palette offers long-lasting wear without creasing. From neutral nudes to bold, glowing tones, it complements all skin tones and is perfect for casual, party, or professional makeup. Compact and travel-friendly, it is ideal for beginners and professionals alike.

Key Features
18 pigmented shades with matte, shimmer, and metallic finishes
Versatile colors for natural to bold looks
Smooth texture for easy blending and seamless application
Long-lasting wear that stays fresh all day
Multi-look palette suitable for casual, party, or professional makeup

How to Use
Apply desired shade to eyelids using brush or applicator
Blend for seamless transition between colors
Layer shades for depth and intensity
Use for day or evening makeup looks

Material
High-pigment cosmetic powders, safe colorants, and binding agents

Safety Information
For external use only
Avoid contact with eyes
Keep out of reach of children
Discontinue if irritation occurs

Package Includes
1 × 18 Colors Nude Eyeshadow Palette
